doors.when: Starting a Claude Code agent that owns engineering work on the desk end to end, from plan through review to a merged pull request
doors.confirm: The operator gave go on the outcome, as the using-desk foundation's alignment step asks before work starts.

errors.means: No desk is bound, so the startup line reports setup mode and no boot ran.
errors.fix: Run the onboarding path desk_status names, desk:first-run-bootstrap by default.

errors.means: The SessionStart hook injected no using-desk foundation, so the worker runs on its own short text without Desk's working rules.
errors.fix: Load desk:using-desk before other work, then run desk:session-start.

errors.means: The boot was still running when the session began, so its result arrives with the first Desk tool reply.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, which waits for the boot, before saying anything about the desk's state.

doors.when: Choosing Desk's engineering worker in Copilot CLI, which plans, builds, reviews and merges changes and keeps its tasks on the desk
doors.confirm: The operator gave go on the outcome, as the using-desk foundation's alignment step asks before work starts.

errors.means: No desk is bound, so the startup line reports setup mode and no boot ran.
errors.fix: Run the onboarding path desk_status names, desk:first-run-bootstrap by default.

errors.means: Copilot's sessionStart hook injected no using-desk foundation, so the worker has only its own short text.
errors.fix: Load desk:using-desk with the skill tool, then run desk:session-start.

errors.means: The boot was still running when the session began, so its result arrives with the first Desk tool reply.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, which waits for the boot, before saying anything about the desk's state.

doors.when: Starting a Claude Code agent to watch, time and classify work someone else did, reporting only what the evidence shows
doors.confirm: The evaluator approved the exact text of each issue before it is filed from their account.

errors.means: The work to observe is work this observer did or helped with, so it declines to judge it.
errors.fix: Start a fresh observer session that took no part in the work.

errors.means: Some step left no output, log, run or screenshot, so the report marks it unavailable rather than zero or fine.
errors.fix: Supply the missing records, or accept the gap as stated in the report.

errors.means: No work, host, packet or briefs were named, so the observer has nothing to watch.
errors.fix: Name the work and the host, or hand over the evaluation packet or the evaluator briefs.
